Closure rule v2 (Stage 1, PB-0002). Evidence objects: tokens of 06.source_dependencies classified as SOURCE (15 source ID), MEMBER (06 object ID), CONTEXT (31/33/34 row ID or declared import-reference pattern), or OPEN (UNBOUND:*, dataset ID/origin table/numeric prefix, unrecognised). Dataset tokens are never expanded. The 06 lineage_state is authoritative and must agree with the token classes. Claims and visuals take the lineage of their 06 record (Reading visuals: of their Reading); Readings: source_bindings plus member evidence records (open when a member is not closed); measurement priorities carry no direct binding.

One record per 15_SOURCE_LIBRARY row. metadata_state = DISPLAY_READY when public_card_state is FULL_PUBLIC_CARD or CITATION_CARD, else LOCATOR_ONLY; display fields (title, publisher, document label and date, and the curated summary where present) are carried only when DISPLAY_READY; standalone_resource_card_eligible only for FULL_PUBLIC_CARD (curated); linked_* = sorted object IDs whose closure resolves to the source.

Records in order: pages (02 order; summary = whitespace-normalised full copy truncated to 1,200 characters; search text = full copy), evidence records (summary; search text = summary + definition + period + universe + method + limitations + currentness), Readings (thesis; question + thesis), measurement priorities (route /measurement/#<id>; missing evidence; current + missing + unlocked decision + priority basis), then every source with a primary URL in 15 order: DISPLAY_READY as a source card record, otherwise a generic locator record. Page text resolves {{n:key}} inventory tokens through the public inventory contract (P1.2); an unresolved template token raises.

outputs.transformation: One Page Spec per 02 route (02 order): 02 prose; 03 sections; bindings by route membership (claims 07, evidence objects 06 + evidence_detail instance, visuals 11, measurement 10, Readings 08; /readings/ binds all Readings) with declared overrides; governed arrays are the bound projection records; verification payload = closure records of bound objects; source references = sources resolved by that payload (evidence_detail fallback to the same-ID claim/visual closure); numeric inventory and prohibited inferences per declared rule; constant design fields and per-route internal design intent from controlled inputs. Index sorted by route slug (collection index routes after their children). Section text, full copy and default meta descriptions resolve {{n:key}} inventory tokens through the public inventory contract; each section records resolved_inventory_tokens; a token in a title or authored meta description, or any unresolved template token, raises (P1.2).

Hand-governed navigation and interaction contract maintained in place (NOT generated from the Master). The generator requires its route list to equal 02, rewrites global_navigation (items and routed children, PB-0424) and trust_navigation from 04_NAV_UX, and rebinds authority_binding (Master and Page Spec SHA-256, spec count), per-route search_record_count and public_search_record_count. It also aligns, from that navigation and the route list, the footer link labels, the footer group that mirrors a navigation family (label and order), breadcrumb parent labels, page-family route counts, and a family's prominence when all its routes share one (Pre-Tranche-C P4).

Hand-governed presentation-depth contract maintained in place (NOT generated from the Master). The generator validates every referenced section (route, section_order) against 03 and every referenced visual against 11, and fails otherwise.
